result: Implemented exact Workstream binding for Mission Canvas candidate collection and eligibility. Generated CandidateContribution remains a scope-neutral registry DTO; the core-only ScopedCandidateContribution binding carries an explicit validated MissionCanvasScope, collect_candidates filters foreign bindings before deduplication, and resolve_eligibility emits fail-closed scope_mismatch/not_authorized diagnostics without suspending foreign authority.

omitted_contribution_reasons: canonical candidate authority slice has no presentation contribution

checks: cargo test -p focusa-core mission_canvas_candidate_scope --lib (not run; explicit operator instruction prohibits Cargo)
remaining_checks: cargo test -p focusa-core mission_canvas_candidate_scope --lib remains intentionally unrun because the operator explicitly prohibited Cargo; the Rust source was formatted and parsed by rustfmt and all permitted contract/static gates pass
remaining_work: No unresolved CORE-002 source implementation work remains. Cargo runtime validation is the only deferred check and is prohibited for this pass.

CORE-001.decision: CORE-001 source implementation and generated Workstream identity contract are integrated on this base; its only recorded remainder is prohibited Cargo validation, so the source dependency is complete for CORE-002.

negative_cases.foreign_workstream: ScopedCandidateContribution carries an explicit MissionCanvasScope. collect_candidates omits a foreign binding before profile/activity selection and duplicate-id insertion; resolve_eligibility emits scope_mismatch and an Omitted decision.
negative_cases.missing_authority: CandidateContribution.validate_scope accepts only MissionCanvasScope and delegates to canonical Workstream/Attachment validation. Invalid authority is mapped to not_authorized or scope_mismatch; no project_root, continuity-only, tab, CWD, latest-record, or nearest-candidate inference exists.
negative_cases.stale_revision_cursor: The resolver preserves the context projection_revision on scope omission diagnostics. Candidate scope has no locally invented revision/cursor authority; generated DTO and downstream projection/event revision owners remain unchanged.
negative_cases.unavailable_capability: Existing capability and operation omission behavior remains in resolve_eligibility and runs after scope validation, so a foreign candidate cannot be retained as a capability-suspended contribution.
negative_cases.ineligible_or_empty_contribution: Existing profile/activity, capability, permission, operation, meaningful-content, deterministic ranking, and empty-contribution omission behavior remains unchanged after the scope gate.
negative_cases.ambiguous_legacy_row: No legacy flat input is accepted by CandidateContribution.validate_scope or collect_candidates. Legacy migration/quarantine remains owned by the generated Spec 158 compatibility boundary; no local mapping or guess was added.

acceptance.statement: Foreign-scope candidate is omitted with not_authorized or scope-mismatch diagnostics.
acceptance.proof: Hostile Rust tests cover exact local collection, foreign duplicate shadowing, and resolve_eligibility scope_mismatch diagnostics with EligibilityOutcome::Omitted and the context projection revision.

acceptance.statement: project_root plus continuity_id cannot bind or focus a Work Surface.
acceptance.proof: Candidate validation and binding accept MissionCanvasScope backed by WorkstreamKey/AttachmentKey only; the generated CandidateContribution DTO remains free of local flat authority fields and all CORE-001 identity gates pass.

acceptance.statement: ambiguous legacy rows are quarantined, not guessed.
acceptance.proof: The implementation introduces no legacy resolver or fallback. Spec 158 compatibility/quarantine ownership remains intact and the identity contract gate passes.
